outcome: I can say that an action does not happen, never happens or no longer happens.
explanation: A negative sentence denies something. In careful written French, put ne before the verb and pas after it: je ne parle pas means I do not speak. Ne becomes n' before a vowel sound. Replace pas with jamais for never or plus for no longer. In everyday speech people often drop ne, but practise both parts in writing. A short non means no; pas encore means not yet. After a negative quantity statement, un/une/des often becomes de: je n'ai pas de livre means I have no book.
